apps.versionDescription:
## ⚠️ Not an installable iOS build

This release attaches a **simulator-only, unsigned `.app`** packaged
from CI as a smoke-test artefact. It is **not** something you can
sideload onto an iPhone, TestFlight-install, or drop in the App
Store — iOS distribution requires code signing + an active Apple
Developer Program account, neither of which is wired up in this
workflow.

### What the zip is good for
- Verifying the tagged commit compiles cleanly under Xcode's
  Release configuration.
- Running the build in **Xcode's iOS Simulator** (drag the
  unzipped `DropStation.app` onto a booted simulator).

### What it is *not*
- An IPA. There's no `.ipa` file here.
- Installable on a physical iPhone (even via AltStore / sideload —
  the binary isn't signed with a real cert).
- Ready for TestFlight or the App Store.

Real iPhone distribution will land in a later release once a
signing pipeline is set up — tracked in
[ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

---


## What's Changed
* 0.5.2: active-state dashboard, file-state hierarchy, in-app bug report by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/1
* Docs: branch protection + PR workflow in AGENTS.md by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/2
* Bug report: harden mailto fallback so subject/body survive by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/3
* TestFlight readiness: audit + checklist + mechanical fixes by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/4
* Fix ITMS-90474: iPad PortraitUpsideDown + bump build to 11 by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/5
* Xcode Cloud: bootstrap .xcodeproj via ci_post_clone.sh by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/6
* 0.5.1 #2: real free-disk space in the dashboard hero by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/7
* 0.5.1 #3: self-signed certificate UX (trust-on-first-use + pinning) by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/8
* Docs: sync TestFlight beta status by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/9
* 0.5.1 #4: session-wipe contract tests + Release-visible diagnostics by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/10
* Localization foundation: String Catalog + raw-string conversion by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/11
* Localization #2: Czech translations + catalog populated from source by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/12
* Czech localization: foundation + translation pass by @Wenzlik in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/13

## New Contributors
* @Wenzlik made their first contribution in https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Wenzlik/DropStation/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.3

apps.name: Manuscript
apps.subtitle: Open-source writing studio
apps.localizedDescription: A free native SwiftUI writing app for long-form projects. Organize chapters and scenes, write with rich text backed by Markdown, import Scrivener projects, export to common formats, track writing goals, use iCloud Drive, and optionally connect AI providers with your own API key. This IPA is an unofficial automated build of the upstream open-source project.
apps.versionDescription:
## Version 1.0.2 — What's New

### New
- Import from Markdown, plain text, PDF, HTML, and Word (DOCX on macOS)
- Export to HTML and Scrivener 3 formats
- On-device AI writing assistance powered by Apple Foundation Models
- Text-to-speech with ElevenLabs voice integration
- Favorites for quick access to your most-used documents
- Keywords, collections, and document links for richer organization
- Attach images and PDFs directly to your manuscripts
- Native print support on both iOS and macOS
- Trash folder with soft-delete so nothing is lost by accident
- Automatic backup management to protect your work

### Improved
- Fresh warm brown accent theme across the app
- Redesigned sheet actions with clear checkmark buttons
- Tabbed Settings for easier navigation
- Export button added to the toolbar for faster access
- Streamlined new document creation with blank defaults
- Improved Scrivener 3 export format compliance
- Realistic procedural corkboard background

### Fixed
- iOS document rename now works reliably
- Gradient shader rendering corrected
- DOCX import defaults applied correctly

---

apps.name: KV4P/ATL
apps.subtitle: ESP32 BLE ham-radio companion
apps.localizedDescription: A very niche native SwiftUI companion for KV4P HT amateur-radio hardware. It carries voice and KISS data over Bluetooth LE, supports APRS/AX.25 messaging and beacons, radio memories and control, and works with an ESP32 BLE firmware bridge. This IPA is an unofficial automated build of the upstream GPL source.
